assumptions.provenance: All numeric speed, rate, detour and overhead samples are architect hypotheses, not measured engine statistics or selected unit proxies.
assumptions.routePolicy: Shortest paths on authored bidirectional land corridor centerlines; start/end offset connector lengths added. Routes may need longer native paths.
assumptions.parallelismPolicy: Each staged actor can move independently while an entirely separate 12/9/6-worker pool gathers. Fixed integer food/wood allocation, no worker reassignment. All workers and their 45-second setup are assumptions; neither spawn nor resource placement is implemented.
assumptions.paymentPolicy: Exact stage debit read from o1 resource transactions; 45-second final coordination allowance assumes local payment/positioning can complete there. No optional rewards, protected recovery or borrowed phase-2 stock is spent.

limits: This is not a feasible schedule certificate, lower bound, upper bound, game test or calibrated difficulty. Unmodelled operations can invalidate any inside-window sample.
Collection, payment, packing, interaction availability, collision/congestion, loaded/empty proxy speed, terrain slope, game pause, input order and observer latency need native measurement.
Available worker counts do not prove actual preplaced gatherers, accessible node yields, drop-site distances or rates. Main crew are separate from assumed gatherers.
All seven secondaries are skipped. Early repair/trade portfolios require their own paid route/economic schedules; benefits are not free starting stock.
A sample exactly at expiry fails: the reference deadline is strict and defeat wins the race.
Final untimed dispatch, optional circuits and fun/pacing are outside this first-phase estimate. No history, terrain, native or game status changes.
